end.summary:
Practised representing 11–20 as one ten-bundle and loose ones.
Saanvi identified the loose ones in 14 and 17 during some attempts.
Saanvi repeatedly counted the ten-bundle as one additional item when finding the total.
The bundle-and-ones mix-up remained at the end; teach-back was not passed.
Lesson ended when Saanvi asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Asha practised showing teen numbers as one bundle of ten plus loose ones. Saanvi used the loose-ones digit for 14 and 17 at points, but also mixed up the bundle’s value with counting objects, and this was not corrected by the last attempt. At home, build a bundle of 10 straws and add loose straws, then say together: “one ten and four ones makes fourteen.”
